steps.expect: walkthrough 08 step 3: short 1–3 bubbles, no filler
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const log=document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-log"]');if(!log)return false;const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('[data-side][data-gap]')];const me=rows.filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='me').at(-1);if(!me)return false;const replies=rows.slice(rows.indexOf(me)+1).filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='them').flatMap((r)=>[...r.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="bubble-foo"]')]);const filler=/great question|how can i help you|i apologize for the confusion/i;return replies.length>=1&&replies.length<=3&&!replies.some((b)=>filler.test(b.innerText||''));})()
